label: extension

args.subject: Group booking enquiry – 10 guests in June
args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to check availability for 10 people in June. Could you please let me know which dates are available, the group rates, and any booking conditions?

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
327-420-4923

final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the address from the City Hub review, to ask about availability for 10 people in June. The hotel is listed as "City Hub" in Tokyo.

The email also asks about group rates and booking conditions. It's signed with your name, company, email and phone number. You didn't give specific dates, so I left them open and asked which June dates are available.

I haven't seen a reply yet.
